transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Hi, doctor. Nice to meet you too. Thank you for taking the time to see me. 

Um... well, I guess what brings me in is... I just haven't been eating right lately. It's probably not a huge deal, I don't want to be a bother or complain too much. But... some days I just, well, it's just coffee and maybe a piece of bread for the whole day. I didn't really think much of it until I noticed my pants are hanging pretty loose on me. 

I hope it's okay that I came in for this... is that the right kind of thing to start with?
Are you avoiding food because you’re afraid of gaining weight?

Oh, no, doctor. It's nothing like that, I promise. I'm sorry if I made it sound that way. I don't really worry about getting fat or anything. 

It's just... I just don't really feel hungry, I guess? The thought of eating just doesn't cross my mind much lately. I'm definitely not doing it on purpose to be skinny or anything like that, I swear. I hope I'm explaining this okay... does that make sense?
Have you been feeling down or depressed lately?

Um... I really don't want to sound like I'm just complaining, doctor. I know a lot of people have it way worse than me, so I try not to make a big fuss about it. But... yeah, I guess I have been feeling a little bit down. 

It's just... well, most days I wake up and there's this... this heavy, kind of empty feeling right here in my chest. It just feels like... like nothing good is really waiting for me out there, so I just want to keep my head down and stay out of the way. I try my best to shake it off, I promise I do. I hope it's okay to admit that... does that answer your question?
Have you lost interest in things you usually enjoy?

Well... I mean, I don't want it to sound like I'm just sitting around doing absolutely nothing all day. I try to keep busy, I really do. 

But... I guess, if I'm being honest... things just don't hold my attention the way they used to. Like, I used to really like walking by the lake, and I have these little model kits I used to work on. They're nothing special, just little projects. But lately... they just sit there on the table. I look at them, and it almost feels like... like they belong to somebody else. I just can't seem to find the energy to pick them up. 

I'm probably just being lazy, honestly. I should really try harder to get back into them. Is that... is that the kind of thing you were asking about, doctor?
Have you been having thoughts that life isn’t worth living?

Oh, goodness, no. No, doctor, I promise it's nothing like that. I'm so sorry if I said something to make you worry about me or think I was giving up. 

I mean, I know I just said I've been feeling heavy and empty, but... I definitely don't think about, you know, ending things or that life isn't worth it. I know life is important, and I wouldn't... I wouldn't ever do anything bad. I just try to take it one day at a time, even when it's a little hard. 

I really hope I didn't give you the wrong impression. I'm doing my best to hang in there, I swear I am. I don't want to be any trouble. Is... is it okay that I just feel a little sad, but not that bad?
Have you been having trouble sleeping?

Um... well, I really don't want to make it seem like I'm complaining about every little thing, doctor. I know sleep is hard for a lot of people, and I'm sure it's just stress or something normal like that. I don't want to waste your time with it.

But... I guess, since you're asking... my sleep hasn't been the greatest lately. I try to go to bed at a reasonable hour, I really do. But I just end up lying there for hours, just staring at the wall. Or, if I do manage to drift off, I'll wake up way before the sun even comes up, and then I just... I can't get back to sleep no matter how hard I try. 

And even when I do get some rest, I wake up feeling completely worn out, like I didn't sleep at all. I'm sorry, I know I shouldn't let it get to me so much. I'm probably just not trying hard enough to relax. Does... does that make sense? I hope I'm answering your questions right.
Have you been worrying a lot lately?

Um... no, doctor. Not really. I hope it's okay to say that. I mean, I don't want you to think I'm just ignoring my problems or that I don't care about stuff... I know I should probably be paying more attention to things. 

But my head hasn't really been stuck on worrying. It's mostly just... quiet, I guess. Like I don't even have the energy to get all worked up or nervous about what's going to happen. I try real hard to just keep my head down and not make a fuss or be a bother to anyone. 

Is... is that a good thing? I just want to make sure I'm answering your questions the right way, so I don't mess up your notes or anything.

Um... well, I don't want to make a big deal out of it, doctor. I know a lot of people try really hard to lose weight, so I guess I shouldn't complain. I don't want to sound ungrateful or anything. 

But... I suppose I have lost a little bit of weight. I just... I hardly eat right anymore. I don't mean to be unhealthy, I promise. It's just that some days all I can manage is coffee and maybe a piece of bread. I just don't have the appetite I used to. And... well, my pants are hanging kind of loose on me now. 

I'm sorry, I know I should be taking better care of myself and eating three square meals. I'll try to do better, I really will. Is... is it okay that I just haven't been very hungry? I hope I'm not causing any problems by not eating enough.
Have you been having trouble concentrating?

Um... well, I really don't want to sound like I'm just making excuses for being slow, doctor. I know everybody gets distracted sometimes, and I'm sure I just need to try harder to pay attention. I don't want you to think I'm just being lazy. 

But... I guess, if I'm being completely honest... my mind just won't stay put lately. Like, I'll try to sit down and look at some forms, or try to do the bills, and I just... I can't keep my head on it. It's like I'm looking right at the paper but nothing is sticking. 

And it's really embarrassing, but it happens with the littlest things, too. I'll go to the store, and I'll just stand there in the aisle for the longest time, completely stuck over something silly like what can of soup to buy. I just stare at them and I can't seem to decide. I know it's stupid, and I should just pick one and go... I'm sorry, I know I should be sharper than that. I'm really trying my best to keep my mind on track. 

Is... is that the kind of thing you were asking about? I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right answers.
